definitions.explanation: When all items of a product have been purchased and none remain for sale.

examples.japanese: チケットは{売|う}り{切|き}れです。
{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}がすぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The popular product sold out quickly.

examples.japanese: {限定|げんてい}{品|ひん}は{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}で{売|う}り{切|き}れになった。
examples.english: The limited edition item sold out 30 minutes after going on sale.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}り{切|き}れになる: to become sold out
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ{御免|ごめん}: while supplies last
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ{続出|ぞくしゅつ}: selling out one after another

GRAMMAR:
Also used as a verb: {売|う}り{切|き}れる (to sell out).

RELATED:
- {品切|しなぎ}れ: out of stock
- {完売|かんばい}: completely sold out
- {在庫|ざいこ}なし: no stock
